change.summary: Typed boss prompts, presence-based walls, dormant whole-entity tick and active-participant exclusion from overlapping lobby protection. MineRENT report supplied; local acceptance remains pending.

modifiers.before: Every discovered structure produces a wall even when no boss or party exists.
modifiers.after: Rendering, collision and teleport policy share live registered boss OR open party presence, cached for one level tick; saved arena identity and revival remain intact.

modifiers.before: Nearby held boss or unauthorized overlapping structure cancels all incoming damage and player death, even for an ALIVE participant in another active hosted encounter.
modifiers.after: Canonical active ALIVE hosted participant bypasses waiting-area immunity; ordinary hosted combat validates attackers/participants. Held bosses still cannot attack anyone.

modifiers.before: NoAI stops goals but Bosses Rise custom tick reactivates bars/music and runs attacks/cinematics.
modifiers.after: Dedicated ServerLevel tickNonPassenger skips held boss native tick until canonical Start removes the lobby marker; no client/integrated tick interception.

modifiers.before: String API accepted BOSS despite EventEntryKind lacking that value; deployed client crash supplied. Existing source producer already corrected in4dc02558.
modifiers.after: Prompt producers accept EventEntryKind and serialize name; no invented legacy alias or wire change.
